desbloquear_5000_tarjetas_activas_voces_: 解锁 5,000 张活跃卡片、高清语音与优先同步。
selecciona_tu_idioma_preferido: 选择应用界面的首选语言。
activo_a_partir_de_ahora_se_registra_la_: Active. Card activity is now recorded and Activity, Summary, and Ranking views are available.
activo_se_registra_la_actividad_de_tus_t: Active. Card activity is recorded and the Activity view will be available.
desactivado_por_defecto_tus_tarjetas_no_: Disabled by default. Your cards do not record activity or game counters.
guarda_los_audios_de_tus_intentos_en_mod: Saves audio of your voice study attempts. Files are deleted automatically.
funcion_premium_actualiza_tu_plan_para_g: Premium feature. Upgrade your plan to store your audio in the cloud.
activo_las_grabaciones_se_suben_a_la_nub: Active. Recordings are uploaded to the cloud and automatically deleted.
desactivado_por_defecto_no_se_guardan_au: Disabled by default. No audio is stored.
si_el_reconocimiento_del_navegador_falla: If browser recognition fails up to 3 times in a row, external recognition activates automatically.
activo_tenes_hasta_3_intentos_antes_de_q: Active. You have up to 3 attempts before external recognition is tried.
desactivado_por_defecto_si_falla_el_reco: Disabled by default. If browser recognition fails, the answer is marked incorrect.
al_importar_texto_csv_o_youtube_si_super: When importing text, CSV, or YouTube, exceeding this limit automatically splits into multiple decks.

stt_chiptt_note: 高级音质 · 需要录音

stt_vosk_download_note: 需要网络连接以下载模型
